integrity: The proof derives the component decomposition directly from torsion cosets and the behavior of multiplication by 2. Exhaustive finite computations are corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to finite nonzero unitary modules for which the torsion set is a submodule.
No classification is asserted when the torsion set is not additively closed.

The complete 2014 zero-deleted-graph article was unavailable through the inspected full-text path; its abstract and bibliographic metadata were inspected, so theorem-level overlap with that source remains the principal literature risk.
